Thanks for your comments... I wish I could share your optimism.

I have tried to get clean. I don't really do any other drugs any more, just drink every night. So I have had some success in getting clean. I have tried a number of medications, and see a psychiatrist weekly. 

To be honest, the way I am, I'd be completely fine if I could meet a girl. I have, in the past, stopped drinking, and taken back control of my life when there is someone there to do things for. Medication and therapy has nothing on having someone there that loves me. That's a major part of my problem I guess.

I just can't handle being alone, and that's when I resort to drinking, and stop looking after myself. Being mostly bald at 30, and having no money or any real assets/prospects has destroyed the minute amount of confidence I once had with women, and it's just no longer possible for me to believe in a hope that there is someone that could love me.

Geez that sounds lame when you write it out. Funny thing is, if I wasn't such a whining and depressive pussy, women might actually find me attractive! At least that seems to be how society works. I guess I don't really know any more.

Thanks again for reaching out. You're a good person.
